description: Detects rising, falling, or both edges on a boolean input and generates a timed output pulse.

inputs.name: Input
inputs.description: Boolean signal to monitor for edge transitions.

outputs.name: Output
outputs.description: Pulse output. Goes high for the configured pulse duration when an edge is detected.

config.name: Direction
config.description: Which edge transitions to detect. Rising detects false-to-true, Falling detects true-to-false, Both detects any change.

config.name: Pulse duration
config.description: Duration of the output pulse generated on each detected edge.

config.name: Startup delay
config.description: Time after system boot during which edge detection is suppressed. Prevents false triggers from peripherals initializing. Set to 0 to disable.

state.name: Previous input state
state.description: Stores the previous state of the input to detect transitions.

state.name: Initialized
state.description: Tracks whether the block has received at least one input event. The first event establishes a baseline without triggering edge detection.
